title: Maltese legend of giants building the temples

tellings.quote: the Maltese legends in that area are that there were giants once on these islands and that they helped build these temples

plain: Local legends on Malta, a small island nation in the Mediterranean that has very old stone temples, say giants once lived on the islands and helped build those temples. A researcher of ancient sites named Jay Anderson, who has been to Malta, repeats the legend as he heard it there. He tells it as a hint that the temple builders may not have been ordinary people.
